scope: parking (parking, stopping and standing a vehicle, and where each is not allowed)

vocabulary.definition: The person driving or in control of the vehicle, including when parking, stopping or leaving it.
To stop and leave a vehicle standing at the side of the road or in a parking space, other than briefly in traffic.
To park in line with the road and with other parked vehicles.
The part of the road set aside for pedestrians to cross, often marked with white (or, at schools, yellow) lines; not all crosswalks are marked.
A space set aside for pedestrians waiting for buses, streetcars and trolleys, marked by raised buttons or markers on the road.
Any place where one road meets another road.
An intersection where traffic travels in one direction around a central island.

rules.title: Bicycle lane use only for parking, entering or turning
rules.when: a bicycle lane runs alongside the DRIVER's lane
rules.action: drive in the bicycle lane
rules.unless: the DRIVER is about to PARK where permitted OR is entering or leaving the road OR is turning within 200 feet of an INTERSECTION
rules.statement: WHEN a bicycle lane runs alongside the DRIVER's lane, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive in the bicycle lane, UNLESS the DRIVER is about to PARK where permitted OR is entering or leaving the road OR is turning within 200 feet of an INTERSECTION.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say how permission is shown

rules.note: Handbook says it is illegal to drive in a bicycle lane except in these cases.

rules.title: No stopping or parking in bus-only areas
rules.when: in an area or lane signed for public transit buses only
rules.action: stop, PARK, or leave the vehicle there
rules.statement: WHEN in an area or lane signed for public transit buses only, the DRIVER MUST NOT stop, PARK, or leave the vehicle there.
rules.note: The same block also prohibits driving in the bus area but allows crossing it to make a right turn.

rules.title: Signal before pulling to or away from the curb
rules.when: about to pull next to the curb or away from the curb
rules.action: signal
rules.statement: WHEN about to pull next to the curb or away from the curb, the DRIVER SHOULD signal.
rules.note: 9.28 says to always signal when stopping; 9.33 words the curb case as 'should'.

rules.title: Check blind spots when parking or leaving a space
rules.when: about to leave a parking space OR PARALLEL PARK OR pull out from the curb
rules.action: check the blind spots by looking over the right and left shoulders
rules.statement: WHEN about to leave a parking space OR PARALLEL PARK OR pull out from the curb, the DRIVER MUST check the blind spots by looking over the right and left shoulders.

rules.title: Check traffic behind when pulling in or out
rules.when: stopping to pull into a parking space OR pulling up to or away from the curb
rules.action: check traffic behind using the rearview mirror, the side mirrors and turning the head
rules.statement: WHEN stopping to pull into a parking space OR pulling up to or away from the curb, the DRIVER MUST check traffic behind using the rearview mirror, the side mirrors and turning the head.

rules.title: Look before opening the door after parking
rules.when: the vehicle is parked AND the DRIVER is about to open the door or exit
rules.action: look carefully for passing vehicles, bicycles and motorcycles and exit only when safe
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is parked AND the DRIVER is about to open the door or exit, the DRIVER MUST look carefully for passing vehicles, bicycles and motorcycles and exit only when safe.
rules.note: Combines 11.12 with the blind-spot check before opening the door (15.33) and the motorcyclist check (13.40).

rules.title: No young child left unattended
rules.when: leaving the vehicle AND a child six years old or younger is in it
rules.action: leave the child unattended in the vehicle
rules.unless: the child is left under the supervision of a person at least 12 years old
rules.statement: WHEN leaving the vehicle AND a child six years old or younger is in it, the DRIVER MUST NOT leave the child unattended in the vehicle, UNLESS the child is left under the supervision of a person at least 12 years old.

rules.title: No children or animals in a hot vehicle
rules.when: the vehicle is parked AND it is hot or sitting in the sun
rules.action: leave children or animals in the vehicle, even with a window slightly open
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is parked AND it is hot or sitting in the sun, the DRIVER MUST NOT leave children or animals in the vehicle, even with a window slightly open.
rules.note: Handbook calls this dangerous and illegal, and says inside temperature can rise rapidly in the sun.

rules.title: Choose a long enough space and signal
rules.when: about to PARALLEL PARK
rules.action: choose a space at least three feet longer than the vehicle and turn on the signal to show the plan to park
rules.statement: WHEN about to PARALLEL PARK, the DRIVER MUST choose a space at least three feet longer than the vehicle and turn on the signal to show the plan to park.
rules.note: Group code PARK used for parallel parking steps.

rules.title: Pull up alongside the front vehicle
rules.when: about to PARALLEL PARK AND a space has been found
rules.action: pull up alongside the vehicle in front of the space leaving about two feet between the vehicles, stop once the rear bumper is aligned with the front of the space, and keep the signal on
rules.statement: WHEN about to PARALLEL PARK AND a space has been found, the DRIVER MUST pull up alongside the vehicle in front of the space leaving about two feet between the vehicles, stop once the rear bumper is aligned with the front of the space, and keep the signal on.
rules.note: Diagram 11.6 shows the vehicle stopped alongside the car ahead of the space.

rules.title: Check blind spots before backing in
rules.when: stopped alongside the vehicle in front of the space while PARALLEL PARKING
rules.action: look in the rearview mirror and over the shoulder for approaching vehicles and pedestrians before backing
rules.statement: WHEN stopped alongside the vehicle in front of the space while PARALLEL PARKING, the DRIVER MUST look in the rearview mirror and over the shoulder for approaching vehicles and pedestrians before backing.

rules.title: Back in at about 45 degrees
rules.when: backing into a space while PARALLEL PARKING
rules.action: turn the steering wheel to back into the space at about a 45-degree angle
rules.statement: WHEN backing into a space while PARALLEL PARKING, the DRIVER MUST turn the steering wheel to back into the space at about a 45-degree angle.
rules.note: Diagram 11.9 shows the 45-degree angle.

rules.title: Straighten out within 18 inches of the curb
rules.when: backing into a space while PARALLEL PARKING AND the rear wheel is within 18 inches of the curb
rules.action: turn the steering wheel away from the curb and straighten out, pulling forward and backward if needed, so the vehicle ends parallel to and within 18 inches of the curb
rules.statement: WHEN backing into a space while PARALLEL PARKING AND the rear wheel is within 18 inches of the curb, the DRIVER MUST turn the steering wheel away from the curb and straighten out, pulling forward and backward if needed, so the vehicle ends parallel to and within 18 inches of the curb.
rules.note: The final position is worded 'should now be parallel and within 18 inches'; diagram 11.11 shows the finished position.

rules.title: Secure the vehicle after parking
rules.when: the vehicle is PARALLEL PARKED
rules.action: turn off the vehicle and set the parking brake
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is PARALLEL PARKED, the DRIVER MUST turn off the vehicle and set the parking brake.

rules.title: Parking brake and gear on a hill
rules.when: PARKING on a hill
rules.action: set the parking brake and leave the vehicle in park, or in gear for a manual transmission
rules.statement: WHEN PARKING on a hill, the DRIVER MUST set the parking brake and leave the vehicle in park, or in gear for a manual transmission.
rules.note: Reason given: the vehicle could roll due to equipment failure.

rules.title: Sloping driveway
rules.when: PARKING on a sloping driveway
rules.action: turn the wheels so the vehicle will not roll into the street, leave it in park and set the parking brake
rules.statement: WHEN PARKING on a sloping driveway, the DRIVER MUST turn the wheels so the vehicle will not roll into the street, leave it in park and set the parking brake.

rules.title: Downhill: wheels toward the curb
rules.when: PARKING headed downhill
rules.action: turn the front wheels into the curb or right toward the side of the road
rules.statement: WHEN PARKING headed downhill, the DRIVER MUST turn the front wheels into the curb or right toward the side of the road.
rules.note: Diagram 11.21 shows the wheels turned toward the curb.

rules.title: Uphill with curb: wheels away from the curb
rules.when: PARKING headed uphill AND there is a curb
rules.action: turn the front wheels away from the curb (left, toward the center of the road) and let the vehicle roll back a few inches so the wheel gently touches the curb
rules.statement: WHEN PARKING headed uphill AND there is a curb, the DRIVER MUST turn the front wheels away from the curb (left, toward the center of the road) and let the vehicle roll back a few inches so the wheel gently touches the curb.
rules.note: Diagram 11.21 shows the wheels turned away from the curb.

rules.title: No curb: wheels to the right
rules.when: PARKING headed uphill or downhill AND there is no curb
rules.action: turn the wheels to the right so the vehicle will roll away from the center of the road if the brakes fail
rules.statement: WHEN PARKING headed uphill or downhill AND there is no curb, the DRIVER MUST turn the wheels to the right so the vehicle will roll away from the center of the road if the brakes fail.
rules.note: Diagram 11.21 shows wheels turned toward the shoulder.

rules.title: White curb: passenger pick-up and drop-off only
rules.when: stopped at a white painted curb
rules.action: stop longer than needed to pick up or drop off passengers
rules.statement: WHEN stopped at a white painted curb, the DRIVER MUST NOT stop longer than needed to pick up or drop off passengers.
rules.note: Painted curbs are regulatory markings ('special parking rules'); handbook words it 'Stop only long enough'.

rules.title: Green curb: limited-time parking
rules.when: PARKED at a green painted curb
rules.action: PARK longer than the time limit posted on signs or painted on the curb
rules.statement: WHEN PARKED at a green painted curb, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK longer than the time limit posted on signs or painted on the curb.

rules.title: Yellow curb: loading only, within posted time
rules.when: stopped at a yellow painted curb
rules.action: stop to load and unload passengers and freight, for no longer than the time posted
rules.statement: WHEN stopped at a yellow painted curb, the DRIVER MAY ONLY stop to load and unload passengers and freight, for no longer than the time posted.
rules.note: Force REQUIREMENT with MAY ONLY would conflict with the table; see force note: handbook wording 'Do not stop longer than the time posted' is a prohibition.

rules.title: Yellow curb: stay with a noncommercial vehicle
rules.when: stopped at a yellow painted curb
rules.action: stay with the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN stopped at a yellow painted curb, the DRIVER of a noncommercial vehicle MUST stay with the vehicle.
rules.note: Handbook says drivers of noncommercial vehicles are 'usually required' to stay; the exceptions are not given.

rules.title: Red curb: no stopping, standing or parking
rules.when: at a red painted curb
rules.action: stop, stand, or PARK
rules.unless: the DRIVER is driving a bus AND the red zone is marked for buses only
rules.statement: WHEN at a red painted curb, the DRIVER MUST NOT stop, stand, or PARK, UNLESS the DRIVER is driving a bus AND the red zone is marked for buses only.
rules.note: Diagram 11.29 shows a red curb at a BUS sign.

rules.title: Blue curb: disabled parking only
rules.when: at a blue painted curb or a space marked with the disabled person parking sign
rules.action: PARK there if the DRIVER is a disabled person or is driving a disabled person, with a special placard or special license plate
rules.statement: WHEN at a blue painted curb or a space marked with the disabled person parking sign, the DRIVER MAY ONLY PARK there if the DRIVER is a disabled person or is driving a disabled person, with a special placard or special license plate.
rules.note: The sign in 11.36 is the disabled person parking symbol.

rules.title: NO PARKING sign
rules.when: a NO PARKING sign is posted
rules.action: PARK or leave the vehicle there
rules.statement: WHEN a NO PARKING sign is posted, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or leave the vehicle there.
rules.note: Listed under 'Illegal Parking' with 'Never park or leave your vehicle'. 12.89 shows a NO PARKING ANY TIME sign.

rules.title: Not on a crosswalk
rules.when: on a marked or unmarked CROSSWALK
rules.action: PARK or leave the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN on a marked or unmarked CROSSWALK, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or leave the vehicle.

rules.title: Not on a sidewalk or in front of a driveway
rules.when: on a sidewalk OR partially blocking a sidewalk OR in front of a driveway
rules.action: PARK or leave the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN on a sidewalk OR partially blocking a sidewalk OR in front of a driveway, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or leave the vehicle.

rules.title: Not near a disabled sidewalk ramp
rules.when: within three feet of a sidewalk ramp for disabled persons
rules.action: PARK or leave the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN within three feet of a sidewalk ramp for disabled persons, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or leave the vehicle.

rules.title: Not at a wheelchair-access curb
rules.when: in front of or on a curb that provides wheelchair access to a sidewalk
rules.action: PARK or leave the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN in front of or on a curb that provides wheelchair access to a sidewalk, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or leave the vehicle.

rules.title: Not in the crosshatched area by a disabled space
rules.when: in the crosshatched (diagonal lines) area next to a designated disabled parking space
rules.action: PARK or leave the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN in the crosshatched (diagonal lines) area next to a designated disabled parking space, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or leave the vehicle.
rules.note: Figure 11.37 shows the white diagonal-striped area beside a disabled space.

rules.title: Zero-emission vehicle spaces
rules.when: at a space designated for parking or fueling zero-emission vehicles
rules.action: PARK or leave the vehicle there
rules.unless: the DRIVER is driving a zero-emission vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN at a space designated for parking or fueling zero-emission vehicles, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or leave the vehicle there, UNLESS the DRIVER is driving a zero-emission vehicle.
rules.note: 11.59-11.60 show that EV charging spaces may be reserved on public streets, marked with an EV sign.

rules.title: Not in a tunnel or on a bridge
rules.when: in a tunnel or on a bridge
rules.action: PARK or leave the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN in a tunnel or on a bridge, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or leave the vehicle, UNLESS PARKING is permitted by signs.

rules.title: Not near a fire hydrant or fire station driveway
rules.when: within 15 feet of a fire hydrant or fire station driveway
rules.action: PARK or leave the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN within 15 feet of a fire hydrant or fire station driveway, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or leave the vehicle.

rules.title: Not near a crosswalk
rules.when: within 20 feet of a marked or unmarked CROSSWALK OR within 15 feet of a CROSSWALK where a curb extension is present
rules.action: PARK or leave the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN within 20 feet of a marked or unmarked CROSSWALK OR within 15 feet of a CROSSWALK where a curb extension is present, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or leave the vehicle.
rules.note: As worded, the 15-foot curb-extension distance is inside the 20-foot distance; it likely means 15 feet replaces 20 feet where a curb extension exists. Checker should read the wording both ways.

rules.title: Not between a safety zone and the curb
rules.when: between a SAFETY ZONE and the curb
rules.action: PARK or leave the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN between a SAFETY ZONE and the curb, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or leave the vehicle.

rules.title: No double parking
rules.when: next to a vehicle already parked at the curb
rules.action: double park or leave the vehicle double parked
rules.statement: WHEN next to a vehicle already parked at the curb, the DRIVER MUST NOT double park or leave the vehicle double parked.

rules.title: Not on the wrong side of the street or on a freeway
rules.when: on the wrong side of the street OR on a freeway
rules.action: PARK or leave the vehicle
rules.unless: there is an emergency OR a law enforcement officer requires a stop OR a stop is specifically permitted
rules.statement: WHEN on the wrong side of the street OR on a freeway, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or leave the vehicle, UNLESS there is an emergency OR a law enforcement officer requires a stop OR a stop is specifically permitted.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say how permission is shown

rules.title: Do not stop in or block an intersection
rules.when: there is not enough space to completely cross an INTERSECTION before the traffic signal light turns red
rules.action: enter, stop in, or block the INTERSECTION
rules.statement: WHEN there is not enough space to completely cross an INTERSECTION before the traffic signal light turns red, the DRIVER MUST NOT enter, stop in, or block the INTERSECTION.
rules.note: 12.100 states it is against the law; 12.31 gives the same as a command for a green light. 12.89 shows a DO NOT BLOCK INTERSECTION sign.

rules.title: Never stop on railroad tracks
rules.when: at a railroad crossing
rules.action: stop on the tracks or begin crossing without enough room to completely cross the tracks
rules.statement: WHEN at a railroad crossing, the DRIVER MUST NOT stop on the tracks or begin crossing without enough room to completely cross the tracks.
rules.note: Reason given: risk of injury or death.

rules.title: Do not stop in the middle of a crosswalk
rules.when: stopping at a CROSSWALK
rules.action: stop in the middle of the CROSSWALK
rules.statement: WHEN stopping at a CROSSWALK, the DRIVER MUST NOT stop in the middle of the CROSSWALK.
rules.note: Reason given: it could force a blind pedestrian to walk into traffic outside the crosswalk.

rules.title: Do not stop in a roundabout
rules.when: travelling in a ROUNDABOUT
rules.action: stop
rules.statement: WHEN travelling in a ROUNDABOUT, the DRIVER MUST NOT stop.

rules.title: Flashers when stopping for vehicle trouble
rules.when: the DRIVER needs to stop because of vehicle trouble
rules.action: turn on the emergency flashers, or the turn signals if the vehicle has no emergency flashers
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER needs to stop because of vehicle trouble, the DRIVER MUST turn on the emergency flashers, or the turn signals if the vehicle has no emergency flashers.
rules.note: On a freeway, 17.48 instead leaves flashers to the driver's discretion (see PARK-EMER-08).

rules.title: Pull off the road away from traffic
rules.when: the DRIVER needs to stop because of vehicle trouble
rules.action: pull off the road away from all traffic if possible
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER needs to stop because of vehicle trouble, the DRIVER MUST pull off the road away from all traffic if possible.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say when it is not possible

rules.title: Stop where visible from behind
rules.when: the DRIVER needs to stop because of vehicle trouble AND cannot get completely off the road
rules.action: stop where people can see the DRIVER and the vehicle from behind
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER needs to stop because of vehicle trouble AND cannot get completely off the road, the DRIVER MUST stop where people can see the DRIVER and the vehicle from behind.

rules.title: Not just over a hill or around a curve
rules.when: the DRIVER needs to stop because of vehicle trouble
rules.action: stop just over a hill or just around a curve
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER needs to stop because of vehicle trouble, the DRIVER MUST NOT stop just over a hill or just around a curve.

vague_terms.term: just over a hill or just around a curve

rules.note: Reason given: other drivers may not see the vehicle in time to avoid a collision.

rules.title: Freeway breakdown: pull to the right shoulder
rules.when: the vehicle stops working on a freeway
rules.action: safely pull over to the right shoulder
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle stops working on a freeway, the DRIVER MUST safely pull over to the right shoulder.

rules.title: Stopping on a freeway: completely off the pavement
rules.when: the DRIVER must stop on a freeway
rules.action: PARK completely off the pavement
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER must stop on a freeway, the DRIVER MUST PARK completely off the pavement.
rules.penalty: A vehicle stopped, parked or left standing on a freeway for more than four hours may be removed.

rules.title: Stay in the vehicle until help arrives
rules.when: stopped on a freeway or roadside because of vehicle trouble
rules.action: stay inside the vehicle with the doors locked and seat belt on until help arrives
rules.unless: there is not enough space on the shoulder OR there is a guardrail OR there is an area to safely stay away from the freeway lanes
rules.statement: WHEN stopped on a freeway or roadside because of vehicle trouble, the DRIVER MUST stay inside the vehicle with the doors locked and seat belt on until help arrives, UNLESS there is not enough space on the shoulder OR there is a guardrail OR there is an area to safely stay away from the freeway lanes.
rules.note: Combines 9.65, 11.57 and 17.47; 17.49 lists circumstances where it is safer to get out and stay away from the vehicle.

rules.title: Exit and re-enter on the right side
rules.when: the vehicle is disabled on a freeway AND the DRIVER must get out
rules.action: exit and get back in on the right side, away from traffic, and return to the vehicle as soon as possible
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is disabled on a freeway AND the DRIVER must get out, the DRIVER MUST exit and get back in on the right side, away from traffic, and return to the vehicle as soon as possible.

rules.title: Emergency flashers on a disabled freeway vehicle
rules.when: the vehicle is disabled on the freeway shoulder
rules.action: use the emergency flashers at the DRIVER's discretion
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is disabled on the freeway shoulder, the DRIVER MAY use the emergency flashers at the DRIVER's discretion.
rules.note: Handbook notes they help other vehicles see you at night and in different weather. Softer than the general instruction in 9.61.

rules.title: Stopping for law enforcement
rules.when: stopped by a law enforcement officer
rules.action: turn on the right turn signal, move completely onto the right shoulder even if in the carpool/HOV lane, and stop in a well-lit area when possible
rules.statement: WHEN stopped by a law enforcement officer, the DRIVER MUST turn on the right turn signal, move completely onto the right shoulder even if in the carpool/HOV lane, and stop in a well-lit area when possible.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say when it is not possible

rules.title: Pulling off the road in thick fog
rules.when: fog becomes too thick to drive safely
rules.action: consider pulling off the road, activating the emergency flashers and waiting for conditions to improve
rules.statement: WHEN fog becomes too thick to drive safely, the DRIVER SHOULD consider pulling off the road, activating the emergency flashers and waiting for conditions to improve.
